contribution_requirements: Follow existing layering strictly: routes -> controllers -> services -> repositories, Zod validators, ok() success envelope, utils/errors.ts subclasses mapped by errorHandler.ts. Role is always server-trusted (roleService + requireTrainer), never client-supplied. Referral codes are lookup data, never credentials — every /api/trainer/* call stays gated by authenticate + requireTrainer + assertTrainerOwnsStudent.
key_patterns: trainerLinks/{studentUid}.trainerId is the authoritative relationship key (NEVER code/email); changing a code must never read/write trainerLinks. trainers/{id}.status==='active' is the single source of truth; `active` is a derived mirror never read for decisions. referralCodes/{codeLower} is a lookup index only; the trainer doc is authoritative for ownership. Shared claimability predicate: claimable by T iff doc missing OR owned by T; unavailable iff owned by a different trainer regardless of `active`. Stored totalStudents is advisory — getProfile overwrites it with live countActiveStudents; the switch path writes NO counter. Code generation: crypto.randomInt, non-sequential, alphabet excludes 0/O/1/I, outer candidate loop (<=5) with an inner all-reads-before-writes transaction; 503 only on exhaustion. dreamphysics is grandfathered by migration (no validator) and reserved so no OTHER trainer can reclaim it.
